name: Hyer Aviation
mood: Luxury aviation editorial with enormous tight-tracked headlines, monochrome white and ink structure, one clay focal accent, pill actions, hard-edged cards, and sculptural aircraft imagery.

deepInk.role: Primary text, footer, filled buttons, icon strokes, and brand structure.

pureWhite.role: Page canvas, white content bands, card surfaces, and text on dark buttons.

coolAsh.role: Secondary body copy, nav items, helper labels, and muted links.

pebble.role: Hairline dividers, borders, and subtle section edges.

midnightHull.role: Full-bleed dark sections and support bands.

charcoalDeck.role: Dark panels and deeper section layers.

clayEmber.role: One featured card, one highlighted offering, or a small decorative focal fill.

fallbacks.display: Neue Haas Grotesk Display, Inter, Helvetica Neue, system-ui, sans-serif

rules: Use HelveticaNowDisplay-style type across the entire system.
Use weight 700 for headlines from 23px upward.
Tighten tracking sharply at display and hero sizes.
Keep body text at 18px with 1.61 line-height.

shadows.none: Cards and buttons rely on surface color contrast and hairline borders, not box-shadow.

components.name: Filled Dark Pill Button
components.recipe: Deep Ink fill, Pure White text, 1000px radius, 15px 22px 16px padding, HelveticaNowDisplay 17px/700.

components.name: Ghost White Pill Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, Pure White text, 1px white border, 1000px radius, used on dark or image-heavy contexts.

components.name: Circular Icon Button
components.recipe: Deep Ink circular hit area with white icon, used for compact menu or navigation affordances.

components.name: Featured Clay Card
components.recipe: Clay Ember fill, Pure White text, 0px radius, 53px 59px padding, used once per page.

components.name: Standard White Card
components.recipe: Pure White fill, 0px radius, no shadow, structured by whitespace and Pebble hairlines.

components.name: Hero Wordmark
components.recipe: Oversized Deep Ink wordmark around 131px, weight 700, tight tracking, flush-left.

components.name: Hero Headline
components.recipe: 60px to 63px, weight 700, line-height 1.0, tight tracking, Deep Ink, ending with a period.

components.name: Section Headline
components.recipe: 37px to 52px, weight 700, line-height 1.0, tight tracking, stacked lines.

components.name: Feature Block
components.recipe: 23px bold title, 18px Cool Ash body at 1.61 line-height, Pebble hairline rule, arranged in a 2x2 grid.

components.name: Dark Content Section
components.recipe: Full-bleed Midnight Hull or Charcoal Deck background with right-aligned white content.

components.name: Footer Terminal
components.recipe: Deep Ink full-bleed footer with oversized white wordmark and Cool Ash link columns.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.recipe: Transparent over hero with 20px nav links and circular icon action.

do: Use huge display type with tight tracking.
Use Deep Ink as the structural text, CTA, icon, and footer color.
Reserve Clay Ember for one featured card or one focal offer.
Use 1000px radius for every button and nav pill.
Keep body copy at 18px with 1.61 leading.
Alternate white sections with dark midnight bands.
End the main hero headline with a period.
dont: Do not add shadows to cards or buttons.
Do not introduce extra accent colors.
Do not use Deep Ink as a light-section page background.
Do not round the featured clay card.
Do not set body copy below 18px.
Do not use thin or light headings.
Do not place two Clay Ember feature blocks in one viewport.
